Date: 2026-09-15T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: Lumen Supply — bank details and remit sample

Hi Maria — thanks for the documents, and welcome.

Next steps from Redwood Procurement / FinOps:
1) Please upload a completed W-9 to the vendor portal link below (required for vendor record).
2) Confirm whether you want ACH as the default payment method for all POs (we can set Wire for specified PO numbers).
3) Confirm the exact PO remittance field you want us to populate (example: PO|InvoiceNumber|CostCenter|Project). We need the example output you want in the "Remittance Info" field on the payment.
4) Our team will send two micro-deposits (small ACH credits) to the account on file to verify the routing/account. Reply to confirm when you see them.

Portal & forms: https://vendor.redwood.com/onboard/ln-supply (upload W-9 / bank evidence)
Estimated timeline: once W-9 + bank proof are in portal, micro-deposits go out within 48 business hours; vendor record usually active within 3 business days after verification.

Marissa (Procurement) — tagging you for PO string guidance; we will need the PO prefix to be added to the remittance CSV so our AP can auto-match.

Let me know if you prefer a quick call.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0123

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: Lumen Supply <vendor@lumensupply.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-16T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: Lumen Supply — bank details and remit sample

Hi Maria — Priyom on FinOps here. Couple of operational items to expedite verification: 

- We will send two micro-deposits (random small amounts) to the account on file within 24–48 hours. When you receive them, reply to this thread with the two exact amounts and we'll complete verification.
- For wires: if you want to accept wires to the same account, confirm a routing and SWIFT block in the portal (we don't store SWIFT in email).
- Remittance mapping: please use the attached sample (we received remit_sample.csv) and confirm that the "PO_TAG" column in your invoices contains the PO prefix you'd like Redwood to populate. Example mapping we plan to send on payments: "PO:{{po_number}}|INV:{{invoice_number}}|CC:{{cost_center}}". If that format is OK, say "ACK format".
- We also need a signed vendor intake form for our records (PDF). If you can attach the signed form to this thread or upload to the portal that will be fine.

If you prefer staff to test a one-off wire to verify wire path, we can arrange a small $50 test wire; otherwise micro-deposits are preferred for ACH verification.

Thanks — Priyom Das
Senior FinOps Analyst | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

From: Maria Gutierrez <vendor@lumensupply.com>

- We uploaded the completed W-9 and the signed vendor intake form to the portal (also attaching signed PDF to this reply).
- We received two micro-deposits this morning: $0.12 and $0.45 — confirming those amounts here for verification.
- ACH is our preferred default. We also confirmed wire instructions in the portal for contingency.
- Remit mapping: ACK format. We will include the PO prefix in the "PO_TAG" column as you requested. Sample row attached (remit_sample.csv).

Attachments: lumensupply_signed_vendor_form.pdf, remit_sample.csv

Please confirm when the vendor record is active and the first PO is issued. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best regards,
Maria Gutierrez

vendor@lumensupply.com | +1 415-555-0199
